gen-gf-unica-one-gf-recursive: Recursive reads friendly and current, tall through the middle of each line. Unica One sits above it as a distinctive display heading, its open curves and uniform strokes giving the sans body something crisp to follow.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-roboto-condensed: Tight, tall and commanding, Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness. Roboto Condensed follows in a sans with enlarged lowercase and barely visible gaps inside words, so a long passage moves along like a taut wire.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Crisp display lettering with generous daylight inside every curve. Saira Semi Condensed sits beside it as a sans-serif that looks magnified yet keeps one steady weight, so the two feel like a loud voice and a measured one.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-secular-one: Unica One's oversized lowercase eye gives its headings a commanding stare. Secular One answers with a sans-serif whose dominant midsection swallows the line height and whose strokes show zero modulation, which is what makes the pair so punchy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-smooch-sans: Rolling-ball pen strokes meet a tightly packed line. Unica One draws its display letters at a single width, while Smooch Sans is a plain sans with a high midline and generous openings inside its s, so the two sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed brings curves that stop short of closing. Its big x-height and tight ascender room sit under Unica One's commanding display heading, and that plain, open, uniform stroke is the strongest thing the pair shares.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-spline-sans-mono: Unica One opens every curve wide, a very large lowercase eye drawn in strokes of one thickness. And Spline Sans Mono, a monospace with fixed-width, code-style letters and lowercase nearly matching its capitals, keeps a long stretch of text precise and ticking along.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 reads clean and approachable, its ascenders looking short because the letters themselves stand so tall. Over a longer passage that gives a compact, steady texture beneath Unica One.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs short ascenders and a tall x-height into a compact line of rounded, open-sided forms. Unica One commands attention, while the plain sans body handles the reading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ubuntu: Unica One brings a commanding, rounded-rod look to headings, every stroke drawn at one thickness. Ubuntu counters with a sans body whose lofty lowercase band makes the running text easy to settle into.
